entries.source: O que ele cria entra na hora, e dá pra desfazer.
entries.approved: What Tuca creates takes effect immediately and can be undone.
previous: What he makes goes in right away, and can be undone.

entries.source: Começa outra conversa com o Tuca, do zero. Esta fica aqui quando você sai e volta.
entries.approved: Starts a new conversation with Tuca, replacing this one. Leaving this page keeps the current conversation.
previous: Starts another conversation with Tuca, from scratch. This one stays here when you leave and come back.

entries.source: Você fala com ele, e ele passa cada parte ao setor certo. Os times abaixo dele são os setores.
entries.approved: Talk to the entry point to send work to the right sector. The teams below it are sectors.
previous: You talk to it, and it passes each part to the right sector. The teams below it are the sectors.

entries.source: Enviado a ${sent}. Acompanhe pelas linhas.
entries.approved: Sent to ${sent}. Track progress along the lines.
previous: Sent to ${sent}. Follow it on the lines.

entries.source: Manda uma notificação agora, pra ver se chega.
entries.approved: Send a test notification.
previous: Sends a notification now, to see that it comes.

entries.source: Quando uma resposta chega no limite e estava avançando, o agente segue sozinho até ${AUTO_CONTINUES} vezes seguidas antes de esperar você. Uma resposta cortada porque o app fechou continua quando ele abre de novo. O limite do mês continua valendo.
entries.approved: At the reply limit, progress allows up to ${AUTO_CONTINUES} continuations before waiting for you. Replies resume after app restart. The monthly limit still applies.
previous: When a reply reaches its limit while it was getting somewhere, the agent goes on by itself up to ${AUTO_CONTINUES} times in a row before waiting for you. A reply cut because the app closed goes on when it opens again. The monthly limit still holds.

entries.source: Chegou nele, o agente pausa. Se estava avançando, segue sozinho (veja Continuar sozinho, abaixo); senão, você decide se continua. Num agente sem limite mensal, a conta é sobre 10 milhões de tokens.
entries.approved: Pauses at the limit. With no monthly limit, the percentage uses 10 million tokens.
previous: When it hits it, the agent pauses. If it was getting somewhere it goes on by itself (see Keep going on its own, below); if not, you decide whether it continues. For an agent with no monthly limit, it is taken over 10 million tokens.

entries.source: O que ele propõe entra assim que ele termina de responder, e o card ganha um Desfazer por ${UNDO_HOURS} horas. Acesso a conectores e o limite do mês continuam esperando você confirmar. Desligado, tudo espera você clicar em Aplicar.
entries.approved: Tuca’s changes apply after his reply, with Undo on the card for ${UNDO_HOURS} hours. Connector access and monthly limits still need confirmation. When off, all changes wait for Apply.
previous: What he proposes goes in as soon as he finishes replying, and the card gets an Undo for ${UNDO_HOURS} hours. Connector access and the monthly limit still wait for you to confirm. Off, everything waits for you to click Apply.

entries.source: Prefira um modelo rápido: ele roda antes de cada resposta num canal.
entries.approved: Choose a fast model: it runs before every channel reply.
previous: Go for a fast model: it runs before every reply in a channel.

entries.source: Onde os agentes rodam: um endpoint seu, sem instalar nada, ou um programa como você configurou (no seu plano, no gateway da empresa ou nos seus provedores). Dos programas, o Tucano nunca vê nem guarda as credenciais; a chave de um endpoint fica guardada aqui, cifrada.
entries.approved: Endpoints need no installation. Runtimes use your plan, gateway or provider. Tucano stores no runtime logins; endpoint keys stay encrypted here.
previous: Where the agents run: an endpoint of yours, with nothing to install, or a program the way you set it up (on your plan, your company’s gateway or your providers). Tucano never sees or stores the programs’ credentials; an endpoint’s key is kept here, encrypted.
Use your endpoint without installing software, or a runtime on your plan, company gateway or provider. Tucano never sees or stores runtime credentials; endpoint keys stay encrypted here.

entries.source: Um erro, uma ideia, qualquer coisa. Também em "Enviar feedback", no pé da barra.
entries.approved: Send a bug report, idea or other feedback, also available at the foot of the sidebar.
previous: A bug, an idea, anything. Also in "Send feedback", at the foot of the sidebar.

entries.source: De vez em quando, uma linha discreta no pé da barra com uma pergunta rápida. Pra isso o Tucano consulta tucano.sh algumas vezes por dia. Não manda nada seu.
entries.approved: Occasionally shows a sidebar survey. Tucano checks tucano.sh a few times a day and sends none of your data.
previous: Now and then, a quiet line at the foot of the sidebar with a quick question. For that, Tucano checks tucano.sh a few times a day. It sends nothing of yours.

entries.source: Abre a lista do que o agente está fazendo embaixo da resposta. Desligado, fica só a linha com o que ele faz agora; um clique nela abre os passos. Muda só pra você.
entries.approved: Shows steps under replies. When off, select the current step to see the list. This affects only you.
previous: Opens the list of what the agent is doing under its reply. Off, only the line with what it’s doing now stays; a click on it opens the steps. It changes only for you.

entries.source: O idioma do app e o que os agentes usam pra responder.
entries.approved: The app language and the agents’ reply language.
previous: The app’s language, and the one the agents reply in.

entries.source: O idioma do app pra você. Os agentes respondem no idioma do Tucano.
entries.approved: Your app language. Agents reply in the workspace language.
previous: The app’s language for you. The agents reply in the Tucano’s language.

entries.source: Como o Tucano aparece pra você. Muda só pra você.
entries.approved: Tucano’s appearance for you only.
previous: How Tucano looks to you. It changes only for you.

entries.source: O texto fica no campo para você revisar antes de enviar.
entries.approved: Review the text before sending.
previous: The text stays in the field for you to review before sending.
Review text in the field before sending.

entries.source: Fale em vez de digitar: clique no microfone do campo de mensagem, ou ⌥ Espaço no Mac e Ctrl+Espaço nos outros, e clique de novo para terminar.
entries.approved: Use the microphone, ⌥ Space (Mac) or Ctrl+Space to dictate; repeat to stop.
previous: Speak instead of typing: click the microphone in the message field, or ⌥ Space on a Mac and Ctrl+Space elsewhere, and click again to finish.
Use the microphone or ⌥ Space (Mac), Ctrl+Space elsewhere; select it again to stop.

previous: the pages’ element list, and sometimes their screenshot, goes to ${providerSpec(c.provider).label}.

entries.source: Tudo deste Tucano num arquivo .zip: agentes, conversas, memórias, wiki e arquivos, pra levar pra um Tucano num servidor (como o Tucano Pro). As senhas dos conectores e os logins de IA não vão: eles ficam presos a este computador.
entries.approved: Export agents, conversations, memories, wiki and files to a .zip for a Tucano server, such as Tucano Pro. Connector passwords and AI logins stay on this computer.
previous: Everything of this Tucano in one .zip: agents, conversations, memories, wiki and files, to take to a Tucano on a server (such as Tucano Pro). Connector passwords and AI logins don't go: they're tied to this computer.

entries.source: Trouxe o Tucano do seu computador? No app do computador, use Exportar tudo (Configurações › Geral) e envie o arquivo aqui: agentes, conversas, memórias, wiki e arquivos substituem os deste Tucano. Um backup diário (.db, da pasta de backups) também serve, só com o banco.
entries.approved: Use Export everything in the desktop app (Settings › General), then import the file here. It replaces this Tucano’s agents, conversations, memories, wiki and files. A daily .db backup from the backups folder restores only the database.
previous: Bringing the Tucano from your computer? In the desktop app, use Export everything (Settings › General) and send the file here: agents, conversations, memories, wiki and files replace this Tucano's. A daily backup (.db, from the backups folder) works too, with the database only.

entries.source: O time num arquivo .md (agentes, skills, canais e rotinas, sem credenciais nem conversas), pra guardar ou levar pra outro computador. Os agentes do OpenBot, do Grok Bot e do Hermes também entram, sem nenhum conector e com a busca na web desligada.
entries.approved: Export agents, skills, channels and routines as .md. No credentials or chats. OpenBot, Grok Bot and Hermes imports: no connectors or web search.
previous: The team in a .md file (agents, skills, channels and routines, without credentials or conversations), to keep or take to another computer. Agents from OpenBot, Grok Bot and Hermes come in too, with no connector and web search off.
Export agents, skills, channels and routines as .md, without credentials or conversations. OpenBot, Grok Bot and Hermes imports have no connectors or web search.

entries.source: Reserva
entries.approved: Fallback
previous: Reserve

entries.source: Quando o principal chega no limite da assinatura.
entries.approved: Used when the main model reaches its subscription limit.
previous: When the main one hits its subscription limit.

entries.source: Quem está acima divide o trabalho com quem está abaixo e recebe a resposta de volta. O desenho organiza, mas não cerca: qualquer agente pode perguntar ou pedir uma parte pequena a qualquer outro.
entries.approved: Agents delegate to those below them and receive their answers. Any agent can still ask another a question or delegate a small task.
previous: Whoever is above splits the work with those below and gets the answer back. The chart organizes but doesn’t fence: any agent may ask any other a question or a small part.

entries.source: Nada sensível acontece sem você. Cada aprovação cobre uma ação exata, e cada pergunta espera a sua resposta.
entries.approved: Review requests for sensitive actions. Each approval covers one specific action, and each question waits for your answer.
previous: Nothing sensitive happens without you. Each approval covers one exact action, and each question waits for your answer.

entries.source: Nenhuma ainda. “Aprovar e sempre permitir”, num pedido, cria uma.
entries.approved: No rules yet. “Approve and always allow” on a request creates one.
previous: None yet. “Approve and always allow”, on a request, makes one.

entries.source: Cada agente tem as suas, na página dele, em Ferramentas. Lá dá pra ver e tirar.
entries.approved: Review and remove each agent’s rules on its page under Tools.
previous: Each agent has its own, on its page, under Tools. That’s where you see and remove them.

entries.source: Depois de ler algo de fora, pedir antes do que não dá pra desfazer
entries.approved: Approve irreversible actions after external content
previous: After reading something from outside, ask before what can’t be undone
Require approval for irreversible actions after reading external content

entries.source: Ele passa a alcançar o que o Tucano alcança aqui: os arquivos e as credenciais que estiverem no disco do servidor. Pra ele usar o seu computador, empreste o computador (abaixo).
entries.approved: It can access Tucano’s files and credentials on the server. To use your computer, lend it below.
previous: It can reach what Tucano reaches here: the files and credentials on the server’s disk. For it to use your computer, lend your computer (below).

entries.source: Este servidor não tem Docker, então o Linux isolado não roda aqui. Pra rodar comandos, use o seu computador (abaixo), ou escolha Nenhum.
entries.approved: Docker is unavailable on this server. Use your computer below to run commands, or select None.
previous: This server has no Docker, so the isolated Linux doesn’t run here. To run commands, use your computer (below), or pick None.

entries.source: A wiki é o que você e o time sabem, em páginas. Com acesso, o agente consulta antes de responder e cita as páginas; lendo e escrevendo, ele também cria e corrige páginas por conta própria.
entries.approved: The wiki holds your team’s shared pages. With access, the agent checks it before replying and cites pages; with read and write access, it also creates and corrects pages on its own.
previous: The wiki is what you and the team know, as pages. With access, the agent looks there before replying and cites the pages; reading and writing, it also creates and corrects pages on its own.

entries.source: Busca na web: pesquisa e lê páginas com a ferramenta do próprio Claude Code ou Codex, na sua assinatura. Cada busca aparece nos passos da resposta.
entries.approved: Web search uses Claude Code’s or Codex’s tools on your subscription to search and read pages. Each search appears in the reply’s steps.
previous: Web search: searches and reads pages with Claude Code’s or Codex’s own tool, on your subscription. Every search shows up in the reply’s steps.

entries.source: Sempre permitido, sem pedir
entries.approved: Always allowed, without approval
previous: Always allowed, without asking

entries.source: Entra sozinho quando algo é da área dele
entries.approved: Joins relevant conversations automatically
previous: Joins on its own when something is in its area

entries.source: Nos canais ligados, ${name} lê e responde quando é com ele. Fora deles, chame com @${draft.handle || 'handle'} ou mande DM.
entries.approved: In enabled channels, ${name} reads messages and replies when relevant. Elsewhere, mention @${draft.handle || 'handle'} or send a DM.
previous: In the channels turned on, ${name} reads and replies when it’s about it. Outside them, call it with @${draft.handle || 'handle'} or send a DM.

entries.source: O agente roda no Claude Code, no Codex ou em outro que você já usa, do jeito que você configurou: no seu plano, no gateway da empresa ou no seu provedor. O esforço diz quanto ele pensa: mais esforço pensa mais e gasta mais do plano.
entries.approved: The agent runs in Claude Code, Codex or another configured runtime, using your plan, company gateway or provider. More effort means longer reasoning and uses more of your plan.
previous: The agent runs in Claude Code, Codex or another one you already use, the way you set it up: on your plan, your company’s gateway or your provider. The effort says how hard it thinks: more effort thinks longer and uses more of your plan.

entries.source: O contexto do workspace já entra em toda conversa. Aqui vai só o que é d${draft.name ? `e ${draft.name}` : 'este agente'}.
entries.approved: Workspace context is included in every conversation. Add only what is specific to ${draft.name || 'this agent'}.
previous: The workspace context already goes into every conversation. Here goes only what’s specific to ${draft.name || 'this agent'}.

entries.source: Como você chama e reconhece o agente no chat. O papel, numa linha, ajuda a decidir quem responde nos canais.
entries.approved: The agent’s name and appearance identify it in chat. Its role helps decide who replies in channels.
previous: How you call and recognize the agent in chat. The role, in one line, helps decide who replies in channels.

entries.source: As mensagens que escreveu continuam nas conversas; o resto foi embora.
entries.approved: Its messages remain in conversations; everything else is deleted.
previous: The messages it wrote stay in the conversations; everything else is gone.

previous: It needs a model.

entries.source: Falta o nome.
entries.approved: Enter a name.
previous: It needs a name.

entries.approved: They also cannot see wiki pages derived from excluded channels.
previous: In the wiki, they also won’t see the pages that came from these channels.

entries.source: Os agentes que ficam de fora também não são chamados a pedido dessa pessoa.
entries.approved: Excluded agents cannot be called on this person’s behalf.
previous: The agents left out are not called on this person’s behalf either.

entries.approved: No agents yet. Build the team to see them here.
previous: There are no agents yet. They show up here once you build the team.

entries.approved: Select sectors or individual agents. New agents in selected sectors are included automatically.
previous: Mark a whole sector, or just some of its agents. Whoever joins a marked sector later shows up on their own.

entries.source: Todos os agentes e canais, como hoje.
entries.approved: All agents and channels.
previous: All agents and channels, as today.

entries.source: Num mês sem esse dia, roda no último.
entries.approved: In shorter months, runs on the last day of the month.
previous: In a month without that day, it runs on the last one.

entries.source: No próximo dia marcado em que o horário ainda não passou. Depois, desliga sozinha.
entries.approved: Runs once at the next scheduled time on a selected day, then turns itself off.
previous: On the next checked day the time hasn’t passed yet. Then it turns itself off.

entries.source: Não deu certo, e não ficou dito por quê.

previous: It didn’t work, and it didn’t say why.

entries.approved: Create a routine with “New routine”, or start from one of these:

previous: No folders yet: the server's file tools don't read or write anything here. Lend your projects' folders. The terminal reaches what you reach, under the same approvals as an agent on this computer.

entries.approved: The server’s file tools can access only these folders. The terminal can access what you can, under the same approvals as an agent on this computer.
previous: The server's file tools only reach these folders. The terminal reaches what you reach, under the same approvals as an agent on this computer.

entries.source: Pra ${lent.map((s) => s.name).join(', ')}: o terminal, o navegador e os conectores deste computador vão junto; as pastas e os apps, só os de baixo. Tudo segue as aprovações configuradas no servidor.
entries.approved: Shared with ${lent.map((s) => s.name).join(', ')}: this computer’s terminal, browser and connectors, plus only the folders and apps listed below. All access follows the approvals set on the server.
previous: To ${lent.map((s) => s.name).join(', ')}: this computer’s terminal, browser and connectors come along; folders and apps, only the ones below. Everything follows the approvals set on the server.

entries.approved: On the server, choose the agents that can use this computer.
previous: Pick, on the server, the agents that use this computer.

entries.approved: The main workspace shares this computer. Its folders and apps are in Settings.
previous: The main workspace lends it: the folders and apps are in its Settings.

entries.source: Os agentes de lá passam a usar o terminal, as pastas que você emprestar, o navegador e os apps deste computador, só quando trabalham pra você, com as aprovações configuradas lá. Funciona enquanto este app estiver aberto. Desligue aqui a qualquer hora.

previous: Its agents get to use this computer’s terminal, the folders you lend, its browser and apps, only when they work for you, under the approvals set there. It works while this app is open. Turn it off here any time.

entries.source: Ao trocar de harness, o agente passa a usar o login padrão dele. O modelo reserva continua igual. Mais esforço pensa mais e gasta mais do plano. Sem modelo escolhido, só o esforço muda e cada agente fica com o modelo dele.
entries.approved: Changing runtimes uses the agent’s default login; fallback stays. More effort takes longer and uses more of your plan. No model selected: only effort changes.
previous: When switching harnesses, the agent uses its default login. The reserve model stays the same. More effort thinks longer and uses more of your plan. With no model picked, only the level changes and each agent keeps its own model.

entries.source: Com um trecho selecionado numa mensagem, ${key} começa uma resposta a ele, sem procurar o botão. Desligado, o atalho não faz nada e o botão da mensagem responde ao trecho do mesmo jeito.
entries.approved: Select message text and press ${key} to reply to that excerpt. When off, use the message’s Reply button.
previous: With text selected in a message, ${key} starts a reply to that excerpt without hunting for the button. Off, the shortcut does nothing and the message’s own button still replies to it.

entries.source: Cada sessão ganha um nome quando começa, feito por um modelo pequeno numa chamada só: ele aparece na linha do agente, ao lado do nome dela, e vira o nome da thread. Sem nada escolhido, usa o modelo da memória.
entries.approved: A small model names each session in one call. The name appears beside the agent and becomes the thread title. Uses the memory model when unset.
previous: Every session gets a name as it starts, made by a small model in one call: it shows on the agent’s line, beside its name, and becomes the thread’s name. With nothing picked, it uses the memory model.

entries.source: Mais de um login do Claude Code, do Codex ou do Antigravity, como a conta do trabalho e a pessoal. Cada agente escolhe a conta na página dele. O login acontece no próprio CLI: o Tucano não vê nem guarda a senha.
entries.approved: Add work or personal Claude Code, Codex or Antigravity accounts; select one per agent. Sign in through the CLI. Tucano never sees or stores passwords.
previous: More than one Claude Code, Codex or Antigravity login, like a work account and a personal one. Each agent picks its account on its page. You sign in through the CLI itself: Tucano never sees or stores the password.

entries.source: Modelos que respondem perguntas fechadas — uma opção entre várias, um sim/não, uma nota — em menos de um segundo e com a probabilidade de cada resposta. O Jev, do TypeSafe, foi o primeiro; a Luna, da OpenAI, e a Decision 1, do Google, fazem o mesmo trabalho, e o Jev também é vendido pelo OpenRouter. Cada um serve um trabalho: quem responde num canal, o que o agente clica numa página.
entries.approved: Fast models choose who replies or what to click. They return a choice, yes/no answer or score with probabilities in under a second.
previous: Models that answer closed questions — one option out of several, a yes/no, a score — in under a second and with each answer’s probability. TypeSafe’s Jev was the first; OpenAI’s Luna and Google’s Decision 1 do the same job, and Jev is also sold through OpenRouter. Each one serves a job: who replies in a channel, what an agent clicks in a page.

entries.source: O navegador dos agentes roda com as extensões que você ligar, para o agente ler a própria página: nenhum aviso de cookies ou anúncio fica por cima dela. Cada uma é um interruptor; as três dividem 215 MB de Chrome for Testing.
entries.approved: Enabled extensions remove ads and cookie notices. They share a 215 MB Chrome for Testing download.
previous: The agents’ browser runs with the extensions you turn on, so what an agent reads is the page itself: no cookie notice or ad sits over it. Each has its own switch; the three share one 215 MB Chrome for Testing download.
